title: 4 MAHINE KI BETI CHHOD AAYI
caption:
Renu Agarwal recounts the difficult decision to leave her 4-month-old daughter behind to visit Mehandipur Balaji. From the Spiritual Awakening podcast.

🎥 Credit: The Spiritual Awakening (Bhakti Prabha) (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ge7d-htYFww)

clip.why: The emotional stakes of leaving a 4-month-old baby behind for a spiritual journey are very high and will stop the scroll.
